## Summary

I've successfully resolved ticket T-5004. The issue was that the api-gateway pods were mounting the gateway-limits ConfigMap using a `subPath` volume mount, which prevents Kubernetes from automatically propagating ConfigMap updates to the pod. Despite the limit being updated in the ConfigMap at 09:10, the gateway pods continued using the old cached 100 req/s limit.

The fix is to remove the `subPath` from the volume mount configuration in the Deployment spec, which will enable automatic hot-reload of limit changes going forward. As an immediate workaround, the team can restart the gateway pods to pick up the updated limits.
